title.context: Budget tab: heading of the card with subscriptions and recurring bills.

intro.message: Subscriptions and bills that come back, like the car insurance: add them to see what they cost a year and what to put aside.

totals.context: Regular costs card: totals. Both formatted money.

subsEmpty.context: Regular costs card: empty subscriptions group, tap to add.

billsEmpty.message: + Add a bill (insurance, car service, taxes…)
billsEmpty.context: Regular costs card: empty bills group, tap to add.

perMonth.context: Regular costs: a monthly amount, short.

dueIn.context: Regular costs list: due soon. {date} is a short date.

setAside.message: The rarer bills need {amount} a month put aside.
setAside.context: Regular costs card: monthly set-aside for bills paid every 2+ months.

fundOk.context: Regular costs card: the bills fund is on track. {name} is a goal.

fundShort.message: {name} has {saved}; to pay the bills on time it should have {should} by now.
fundShort.context: Regular costs card: the bills fund is behind.

noFund.message: No goal is set as the bills fund yet.
noFund.context: Regular costs card: no bills fund.

pickFund.message: Pick or add one on Savings
pickFund.context: Regular costs card: link to the Savings tab to mark a goal as the bills fund.

reviewDue.one: {count} subscription hasn't been checked for 3 months.
reviewDue.other: {count} subscriptions haven't been checked for 3 months.
reviewDue.context: Regular costs card: prompt for the quarterly review.

reviewNow.context: Regular costs card: link that opens the review.

reviewIntro.message: For each one: do you still use it enough for what it costs a year? Cancelled ones are put away here; cancel them with the provider too.

cancelIt.context: Regular costs: cancel (stop) this subscription or bill; it's put away.

restore.context: Regular cost sheet: restore a cancelled one.

reviewSaves.message: That's {amount} a year back in the budget.
reviewSaves.context: Subscription review: what cancelling saves a year.

subPlaceholder.context: Regular cost sheet: name placeholder for a subscription.

billPlaceholder.context: Regular cost sheet: name placeholder for a bill.

amount.context: Regular cost sheet: label of the amount paid each time.

how.context: Regular cost sheet: label of the frequency.

due.context: Regular cost sheet: label of the due date.

dueHelp.message: Any date it's due; the next ones follow from it.
dueHelp.context: Regular cost sheet: help under the due date.

category.context: Regular cost sheet: the spending category it's logged under.
